We are performing maintenance on our SIP infrastructure to improve monitoring and stability. This will result in ~1min downtime.

Who is affected: Calls using Vapi numbers, SIP (sip.vapi.ai), or a BYO SIP trunk will be unable to connect during the maintenance.
Who is not affected: Calls using a native Twilio, Telnyx, or Vonage number connected directly, web callers, or users in the Vapi EU or AUS regions.

When: September 20, 2026, 10:00pm to 10:10pm PT

What to expect: SIP calls will fail to connect for about 1 minute at 10:00pm PT and return the standard error response. We will then validate for the rest of the window while calls connect normally.

Action needed: If one minute of failed calls is a concern, route through an alternate transport such as Twilio for the window.

We will update this page when calls are connecting again and when the work is complete.
Our dashboard login provider's service is degraded. Our API remains functional.
Our login provider has recovered and the Vapi dashboard is fully operational again.

On Sunday, September 13, 2026, from 8:24 a.m. to 10:55 a.m. Pacific Time, Vapi Chat experienced a service disruption on both daily and weekly channels.

During this period, requests to `/session` and `/session/{id}` timed out or returned HTTP 504 (Gateway Timeout) and 500 (Internal Server Error) responses, affecting chat session creation, retrieval, and management.

Service was restored at 10:55 a.m. Pacific Time. All other services, including voice calls, were unaffected on both channels.
